description: This file defines and exports types, functions, and utilities related to allowlist processing, including normalization, matching, and resolution of allowlist entries, with a focus on sender and chat-based allowlist validation.

methods.name: formatAllowFromLowercase
methods.description: Converts allowFrom entries to lowercase, optionally stripping prefixes based on a regex.

methods.name: formatNormalizedAllowFromEntries
methods.description: Normalizes allowFrom entries through a provided parser or canonicalizer.

methods.name: isNormalizedSenderAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a sender ID matches a simple normalized allowlist with wildcard support.

methods.name: isAllowedParsedChatSender
methods.description: Matches chat-aware allowlist entries against sender, chat ID, GUID, or identifier.

methods.name: mapBasicAllowlistResolutionEntries
methods.description: Clones allowlist resolution entries into a serializable shape for UI and documentation.

methods.name: mapAllowlistResolutionInputs
methods.description: Sequentially maps allowlist inputs with side effects in order.
